figma_annotations.title: Geo-Aware Cold Start
figma_annotations.annotation: Homepage loaded with SAR currency, Arabic-script destinations, and Saudi city chips (Jeddah, Mecca, Madinah) without any user input or login. The product already knows where you are and acts on it.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Implement immediately. Saudia's app must detect Saudi/GCC users and load their cultural context by default.

figma_annotations.title: Vibe-Based Trip Planner
figma_annotations.annotation: 9 experience categories replace 'where do you want to go?' with 'what kind of experience do you want?' — a fundamentally different framing of travel inspiration.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Consider for Saudia's destination discovery experience. Framing Saudi destinations by experience type (Heritage, Adventure, Family, Spiritual) aligns with Vision 2030 tourism positioning.

figma_annotations.title: NLP Filter to Facet Translation
figma_annotations.annotation: Natural language query 'pool view and free breakfast with good reviews' → parsed to review_score=70 + mealplan=1. Silent intent dropping is the key limitation: 'pool view' was not mapped.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Build NLP flight search with transparency layer. Show user what was understood. Priority: P0.

figma_annotations.title: Contextual Property Q&A Chips
figma_annotations.annotation: 10 property-specific AI pre-generated questions on every property page. Not generic FAQ — specific to Cloud 7 Residence AlUla ('Is the swimming pool open?', 'Can I park there?'). Eliminates the need to contact the property.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Build flight-specific Q&A chips for every flight detail page. Priority: P0.

figma_annotations.title: Penny Login Gate — Strategic AI Access Decision
figma_annotations.annotation: Penny (Booking.com's AI assistant) is fully gated behind account + booking reference. This is a deliberate strategic choice: AI serves existing customers, not acquisition. The wrong model for Saudia.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Saudia's AI must be accessible pre-login. The AI is a sales tool. Gate it and you lose conversion at the highest-value moment.

figma_annotations.title: AI Booking Intelligence Label
figma_annotations.annotation: 'Perfect for a 4-night stay!' — AI matches the user's specific stay dates against property data and surfaces a confidence signal at the decision point. Zero effort required from the user.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Translate to Saudia: 'Perfect for your long weekend', 'Great connection cushion', 'Top-rated on this route'. Quick Win.

figma_annotations.title: Cultural AI Personalization — Halal Breakfast
figma_annotations.annotation: AI-generated property synopsis explicitly mentions Halal breakfast for Saudi user — not from a filter applied, but from AI adapting the content to detected geography.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Saudia owns this space. Build a Cultural Intelligence Suite: Hajj/Umrah mode, Ramadan mode, prayer time integration, Halal default. No OTA can compete here.

figma_annotations.title: AI Review Topic Clustering
figma_annotations.annotation: 5 AI-clustered topic chips (Breakfast / Room / Swimming pool / Location / Clean) from 1,139 reviews. Clicking 'Breakfast' filters to breakfast-specific review excerpts. Converts unnavigable corpus into AI-indexed retrieval.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Apply to Saudia flight reviews. Surface topic clusters (Crew / Meal / Seat / Timeliness / Entertainment) on route pages. Differentiates Saudia's search results at the decision moment.

figma_annotations.title: AI Neighborhood Summary
figma_annotations.annotation: 'Guests loved walking around the neighborhood!' — AI-synthesized sentiment headline from all guest reviews mentioning the area. Makes location quality instantly clear without reading reviews.
figma_annotations.saudia_action: Apply AI-synthesized location/destination summaries to Saudia's destination pages.

journey_map.note: AI is front-loaded; post-booking AI (Penny) is login-gated and therefore not accessible on public surface
